Vaqta Sachdeva

AI Engineer | Python, Langchain, Tensorflow, Tableau, Alteryx, SQL, AWS, Databricks| Data Strategy & Leadership

Bangalore, India | +91-7259577722 | svaqta@gmail.com

Professional Summary

Strategic and Python-focused AI Engineer with 12+ years in data analytics, engineering, and analytics. Extensive hands-on experience with Python (Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Transformers), cloud platforms (AWS - S3, Lambda), and BI tools (Tableau, Alteryx). Recently specialized in Generative AI, developing LangChain-powered copilots, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and prompt engineering solutions using OpenAI APIs. Adept at integrating LLMs with enterprise data, orchestrating automated insights, and deploying AI-powered dashboards that drive executive decisions. Known for bridging business needs with cutting-edge AI solutions and delivering measurable outcomes.

Technical Skills

Languages: Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn), SQL, VBA

Gen AI & Tools: LangChain, OpenAI, Transformers, FAISS, RAG, FastAPI, Streamlit

Platforms & BI Tools: Tableau, Alteryx, Databricks, Redshift, Adobe Analytics, Salesforce, SharePoint

Automation & Cloud: AWS, Alteryx, Tableau Server

Key Projects

Marketing Insights Copilot (2024)

Stack: LangChain, GPT-4, FastAPI, Streamlit, AWS Bedrock

Summarized campaign data from Adobe Analytics, Eloqua, and Salesforce Campaigns

Designed prompt and retrieval logic for real-time executive insights

Integrated structured and unstructured campaign data using RAG

Reduced reporting time by 60% Insight Automation Pipeline (2024)

Stack: Python, Alteryx, Tableau, Redshift

Automated data prep and visualization updates

Achieved 70% reduction in manual reporting effort



Marketing Agentic Chatbot (2024)

Stack: LangChain, Langgraph, API, AWS EC2

LLM-enhanced interpretation of customer behavior

Performed analysis for a new product launch

Automated lifecycle segmentation, boosting retention by 18% Slack-Based Query Bot for Dashboards (Prototype)

Built Slack-integrated LLM app to generate natural-language summaries of Tableau

dashboards

Provided real-time, on-demand reporting summaries

Professional Experience

Senior Consultant – TE Connectivity Solutions

Bangalore | Apr 2024 – Aug 2025

Designed and deployed LLM-powered executive summary generation system using LangChain, summarizing campaign insights from Adobe, Eloqua, and Salesforce.

Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline to integrate unstructured documents and structured campaign KPIs, enabling real-time, context-rich marketing insights.

Delivered a GPT-4-based performance copilot, significantly reducing time-to-insight for executive reporting.

Designed CI/CD Pipeline using GITHub actions and deploy workflows to AWS

Provided technical and strategic leadership in adopting Gen AI across the marketing analytics function—guided teams on prompt engineering, tool integration, and AI/BI synergy.

Mentored junior analysts and cross-trained functional teams to build AI literacy and data fluency across business units.

Collaborated cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales, and IT to align AI and BI initiatives with core business objectives.

Senior Associate – JP Morgan & Chase

Bangalore | Apr 2021 – Mar 2024

Optimized BAU processes with Alteryx automation and governed change management rollouts.

Built and maintained client survey dashboards, Tableau Server KPIs, and digital adoption metrics.

Used Python to connect real-time data streams into Tableau for interactive visualizations.



Delivered high-impact KPI reporting decks, aligning with business stakeholders.

Identified inefficiencies in existing processes and implemented strategic improvements by Automation and activating legacy dashboards and updating it with newer version

Use Python libraries like Pandas and NumPy for data cleaning, transformation, and built AI driven dashboards in Tableau

Drove data storytelling through Tableau dashboards powered by real-time feeds, campaign segmentation logic, and predictive marketing metrics.

Senior Associate – State Street Corporate Services

Hyderabad | Nov 2019 – Mar 2021

Conducted regular meetings to gather insights and ensure business requirements meet customer needs

Developed automated ETL workflows using Alteryx and Databricks, reducing manual effort by 40%.

Developed prototypes to validate requirements and iteratively refined mockups to gather additional feedback from stakeholders

Spearheaded global dashboard standardization and built scalable Tableau frameworks used across multiple regions

Created different visualizations (Bars, Lines and Pies, Maps, Scatter plots, Bubbles etc., along with advanced visualizations like Pareto, Pyramid and Funnel charts) and implemented level of detail (LOD) expressions for precise data aggregations.

Administered user access controls on Tableau Server, managing permissions and security settings for various user roles.

Optimized Tableau dashboards for performance, addressing factors such as data extract efficiency and dashboard rendering speed

Analyst – BA Continuum India Pvt. Ltd

Hyderabad | Aug 2017 – Nov 2019

Designed, built, and maintained predictive capacity planning models to forecast required FTEs using inputs like volume forecasts, handle-times, and shrinkage assumptions.

Compared forecasted requirements with current team size to identify capacity utilization gaps and support strategic workforce planning.

Partnered with business stakeholders to track contact center performance, develop predictive models, and translate operational data into actionable insights for senior leadership.

Wrote and executed complex SQL queries—joining multiple tables and using subqueries to extract and manipulate data from relational databases for operational analysis.



Automated manual reporting processes using VBA, significantly improving productivity and reducing turnaround time.

Delivered data storytelling through intuitive visualizations, translating complex analysis into business-friendly insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Senior Business Analyst – Ideaspark

Hyderabad | May 2016 – Jul 2017

Performed exploratory data analysis (EDA) to uncover patterns, relationships, and data structure using statistical and visual techniques.

Implemented data cleaning and preprocessing pipelines to ensure high data quality and analytical accuracy.

Built Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) models with clustering algorithms to predict customer behavior and revenue potential.

Developed personalized marketing campaigns based on CLV segments to enhance targeting and retention.

Conducted market basket analysis to identify product affinities and purchase behavior patterns, focusing on multichannel online shoppers.

Performed time series forecasting to predict business trends, new player acquisition, and future margin projections.

Designed interactive Tableau dashboards using action filters, parameters, and calculated sets, enabling KPI tracking across YoY, QoQ, YTD, QTD, and MTD metrics.

Software Engineer – Accenture

Hyderabad | May 2013 – Jan 2016

Designed and implemented logical and physical data models to meet complex business requirements while applying normalization techniques to ensure data integrity and eliminate redundancy.

Developed and optimized complex SQL queries for efficient data retrieval and transformation, using execution plans and indexing strategies to enhance performance.

Created detailed process documentation and requirement specifications to support business analysis and system implementation.

Led end-to-end data migration and upgrade projects, performing rigorous testing and validation to ensure smooth transitions with minimal downtime or data loss.

Worked in Agile and Kanban environments, collaborating in cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality data solutions in iterative development cycles.



Certifications

-Alteryx Designer Core Certification (2021, 2023)

Applied Business Analytics – ISB (2021)

Education

B.Tech in Bioinformatics – VIT University, Vellore (2009–2013) | CGPA: 8.26 Class XII – Army Public School, Kota | 80%

Class X – Sophia School, Kota | 79%
